title: Can You Trick the Grader? Adversarial Persuasion of LLM Judges
reasoning: The paper investigates the vulnerability of LLM judges to persuasive rhetorical techniques. While it touches upon 'fairness' and 'integrity' and includes an ethics statement, its primary focus is on the technical and linguistic susceptibility of automated graders to manipulation in mathematical reasoning tasks, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, faith-based, or ethical frameworks.
